etransfer.methodDescription: Pay from your Canadian bank account after you place the order.
etransfer.title: Pay by Interac e-Transfer
etransfer.intro: Place your order now and send {total} by Interac e-Transfer. We ship as soon as it arrives.
etransfer.step1: Place your order — we email you the e-Transfer details and show them on the next page.
etransfer.step2: Send the e-Transfer from your online banking, with your order number in the message.
etransfer.step3: We confirm your payment and ship your order.
etransfer.introConvert: Place your order now and send the Canadian-dollar equivalent of {total} by Interac e-Transfer. We ship as soon as it arrives.

wvpay.loadFailed: We couldn't load the secure card form. Please refresh the page and try again.

wvpay.securityNote: Your card details go securely and directly to our payment processor, Authorize.net. They never touch our servers.

adyen.pendingApproval: Your payment is waiting for approval. This can take a moment — please don't close this page or pay again.

crypto.methodDescription: Pay with Bitcoin, Ethereum and other coins.
crypto.title: Pay with crypto
crypto.intro: Pay {total} in Bitcoin, Ethereum or another coin. You'll finish on our payment partner's secure page, then come straight back here.
crypto.step1: Choose the coin you want to pay with.
crypto.step2: Send the exact amount shown before the timer runs out.
crypto.step3: Once the network confirms it, your order is placed automatically.
crypto.unavailable: Crypto payments aren't available right now. Please choose another payment method.
crypto.pendingBody: We haven't seen your payment confirmed yet. Crypto transfers can take a few minutes to confirm on the network. If you've already sent it, hang tight — your order is placed as soon as it confirms. Please don't pay again.
crypto.notConfirmed: Still waiting for the network to confirm your payment.
crypto.orderPlaced: Your payment was received and your order has been placed. Check your email for the confirmation.

dummyCard.intro: Test mode — no real charge is made. Use a test card below, or any well-formed card number.

etransfer.title: Send your Interac e-Transfer to finish your order
etransfer.intro: Your order is reserved. We ship it as soon as your payment arrives.
etransfer.matchNote: Please put the message exactly as shown so we can match your payment to your order.
etransfer.autoDeposit: No security question is needed — the money goes straight into our account.
etransfer.emailNote: We've also emailed these details to you.
etransfer.reservedEmail: We've emailed the e-Transfer details to {email}
etransfer.currencyNote: Your order total is in {currency}, but Interac e-Transfers are sent in Canadian dollars — please send the CAD equivalent at the current exchange rate.

identity.title: Zweryfikuj swoją tożsamość
identity.description: Produkty nikotynowe są objęte ograniczeniem wiekowym. Zanim przetworzymy płatność, zweryfikuj swoją tożsamość za pomocą oficjalnego dokumentu tożsamości. Stripe zajmuje się tym bezpiecznie — nigdy nie widzimy ani nie przechowujemy Twojego dokumentu.
